text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following the Kikuka Sho, I speak to Ines Fujin's mother on the phone.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text: My twins are both saying that they want to attend the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text: I need to visit the hospital, and I've asked my husband to accompany me. It really shames me that we can't be there for our daughters…

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text: I want the three of them to get together again and talk. Could I ask you to help out, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry for involving you in our family affairs…
choice_data_list: It's fine. I'm happy to do what I can for Ines.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much. Please take good care of my daughters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Judging from Ines Fujin's behavior and the way her conversations with her sisters have gone up until now…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems they're a little at odds with each other. Having me there as a third party might help ease the tension.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But first, Ines Fujin and I have to decide if she'll actually be racing in the Arima Kinen or just spectating. Later, on the day of the race…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh… you're both here.

text_block_list.name: Little Sister B
text_block_list.text: You're running in the Arima Kinen too, right? Good luck! I know you're gonna crush 'em!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …I'm sorry. I haven't kept any of the promises I made to you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I still haven't made enough money for you to hire a helper for a year, and I made you both worry at the Kikuka Sho…

text_block_list.name: Little Sister B
text_block_list.text: You don't have to apologize. Me and Cassie—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But listen! I promise I'll pull through! Don't worry about helping out around the house or anything like that!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: …We're going to. We're going to help out. We know all about how to do the laundry now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Cassie…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Why?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You're doing too much. You both have dreams of your own, don't you? You don't have to try and—

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: That's not it! We made up our minds. It's OUR decision! We're going to stop dancing and help Mom!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: No… you didn't make that decision—you were forced to make it! By me! I gave you no choice!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: Why can't you just—
choice_data_list: Maybe you are forcing a decision onto them—but not in the way you think.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Well…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: They want to be able to focus on dance practice every day, and go on to win competitions, and…

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: …You're wrong.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: Me and Polly… we just like seeing the whole family smile.

text_block_list.name: Little Sister A
text_block_list.text: That's why we like dancing. When we dance, everyone watches us with big smiles on their faces. But…

text_block_list.name: Little Sister B
text_block_list.text: What we like even more than that is watching you race with all you've got!

text_block_list.name: Little Sister B
text_block_list.text: We want to see you run a whole lot, and smile a whole lot, and win a whole lot…

text_block_list.name: Little Sister B
text_block_list.text: That's this whole family's dream right now!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You guys…

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin, it's almost time for you to enter the paddock!
choice_data_list: Ines, did you hear what your sisters said?
Ines, did you hear what your sisters said?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Then… then what is it?
choice_data_list: It's their dream… and mine too.
It's their dream… and mine too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's not just the stands that are packed for today's Arima Kinen—the paddock's drawn a full crowd too.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: Sooo, basically, everyone's come 'cause they wanna see Oguri's last race.

text_block_list.name: Girl with False Eyelashes
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I know. I mean, Oguri's, like, a super amazing runner, right? Is that it?

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: Well, thing is, she hasn't really been in top form lately. Rumor has it this could be her last run ever.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oguri! You can do it! I believe in you! You can win!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan B
text_block_list.text: Please, Ogurin! Give it all you've got and win!

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: Sooo, people are saying this runner called Mejiro Ryan—who's, like, one of Ines's rivals—might actually, like, win.

text_block_list.name: Girl with False Eyelashes
text_block_list.text: …Whoa. You know, like, so much about this racing stuff lately.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah. I mean, Ines's races are way more fun if you know the whole deal.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey girls! I wasn't expecting to see you two here at the Arima.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: B-Boss! Wh-what about the store? Don't tell me it's closed?!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: Uh, I do employ a lot of part-timers, y'know? Besides, one day off is no big deal… Wait, look—she's coming!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: Some days I just feel like coming out and seeing Ines run—watching her really boosts my spirits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
